ItemID: 1; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful disposable gloves for messy adhesive and resin work, provided their chemical compatibility is suitable.
ItemID: 2; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a pressure measurement project that calls for this gauge.
ItemID: 3; Title: toolant Four Sprial Flute Step Drill Bit, 1/8"-7/8"(3pcs) Impact Ready Titanium Coated Unibit Step Bit, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Metal, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Wood, Plastic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Step bits would complement my existing drill set for enlarging holes in sheet metal for rivets and threaded inserts.
ItemID: 4; Title: FOLIV 265PCS Black Self Tapping Screws, 8 x 1/2” to 1-1/2” (410) Stainless Steel Modified Truss Head Sheet Metal Screws Assortment Kit, Black Oxide Self Drilling, 6 Different Length Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The varied lengths and broad heads look useful for attaching sheet metal in my repair projects.
ItemID: 5; Title: [40 Pack] 1/4" x 1-1/4" OD Stainless Steel Fender Washer - Choose Size Metal Flat Washers for Bolts, 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Wide washers would help spread fastening loads on thin material and complement my bolt assortment.
ItemID: 6; Title: KRAKEN BOND Wow! Super Crazy Glue Clear - Strong Cyanoacrylate (CA) Glue for Plastic, Metal, Wood, PVC, Fast Curing Epoxy Adhesive | 3 Pack, 3.5 Oz.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A fast-setting glue would be handy for small repairs where my mounting tape or bulk resin is inconvenient.
ItemID: 7; Title: breesky Human Heart Torso and Skeleton Model 3D Model Study Tools for Anatomy and Physiology Students Sets of Three Human Anatomy Models Sciences Learning Kit for Kids…; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Anatomy study models do not fit my current workshop and repair interests.
ItemID: 8; Title: Self Tapping Screws Assortment Fasteners Set, 650pcs 304 Stainless Steel M3/M4/M5/M6 Sheet Metal Screws Kit with Storage Box,Phillips Drive Wood Screw Assortment; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The stainless steel sizes fit my fastening needs, though I would check overlap with the screw kits I already have.
ItemID: 9; Title: Forever Merci 50Pcs Black Thank You Merchandise Bags |2.36 mil Extra Thick/Large Size - 12″x15″|Plastic Shopping Bags for Small Business with Strong Die-Cut Handles|Reusable Plastic Thank you Bags; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for merchandise packaging.
ItemID: 10; Title: KEYXE 8Pcs Screw Eyes, 3.2 Inch Black Eye Hooks Screw Self Tapping Eye, Heavy Duty Eye Bolt for Wood Securing Cables Wire, Hammock Stand, Indoor & Outdoor Use; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These could suit a future mounting project, but I do not need large wood screw eyes right now.
